description: Declared mutants of steps 1 and 2 of the asset batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/asset-declaration.zh-Hant.md, sections 9 and 10; ids as- catalog, ar- references, al- loaders, rw- whole-file reading, as-store-/as-snapshot- the store of step 2). Each guards a rule of the declaration (5.3 (A), 5.16, 5.17) or a Design Invariant written there (AS-2, AS-3, AS-9, AS-12, AS-13), to be moved to target/v2/asset.zh-Hant.md in step 6. Run: python3 -B tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --build-dir build/target/_build/core --catalog tests/common/asset/mutations.json --cmake <cmake>
